# Real-world fixtures (W3-B3)

Everything here is saved locally; tests never touch the network. Sizes are all under 600 KB.

| File | Source | Licence / terms | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| pbj_daily_nurse_sample.csv | CMS Payroll-Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing, CY2023 Q4. https://data.cms.gov/sites/default/files/2024-04/0cd535dd-4611-4b0b-8380-65444c2f6236/PBJ_dailynursestaffing_CY2023Q4.csv (landing page https://data.cms.gov/quality-of-care/payroll-based-journal-daily-nurse-staffing) | US Government public data (CMS open data) | First 300 data rows (byte-range download, header intact) |
| co_nurse_licenses.csv | Colorado DORA "Active Nursing Licenses in Colorado", https://data.colorado.gov/resource/gzth-nufs.csv?$limit=300 | Colorado Information Marketplace open data | First 300 rows via Socrata API |
| tx_rn_active.csv | Texas Board of Nursing "RN-Active", https://data.texas.gov/resource/beaa-5hsm.csv?$limit=300 | data.texas.gov open data | First 300 rows |
| tx_rn_cp1252_crlf.csv | Derived from tx_rn_active.csv: "JOHNSON"->"MUNOZ" (with n-tilde), "BRIANNA"->"JOSE" (with acute), re-encoded Windows-1252, CRLF line endings | as above | Encoding test |
| nyc_payroll.csv | NYC Open Data "Citywide Payroll Data (Fiscal Year)", https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/k397-673e.csv?$limit=300 | NYC Open Data terms of use (public) | First 300 rows |
| chicago_employees.csv | City of Chicago "Current Employee Names, Salaries, and Position Titles", https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/xzkq-xp2w.csv?$limit=300 | City of Chicago open data | First 300 rows |
| hr_roster_cp1252_crlf.csv, hr_roster_cp1252_crlf_10rows.csv | Written by the breaker (Harborview HR schema, invented people) | n/a | cp1252 + CRLF, accented names |
| hr_roster_utf8_control.csv | Same content as hr_roster_cp1252_crlf.csv, UTF-8/LF | n/a | Control for the encoding effect |
| pdf/web_calendarlabs_weekly_work_schedule.pdf | https://www.calendarlabs.com/templates/planner/weekly-work-schedule-template.pdf (page https://www.calendarlabs.com/view/weekly-work-schedule-template/5486) | CalendarLabs free template (personal/non-commercial use; licence text not verified) - test fixture only | Produced by Microsoft Excel 2019 |
| pdf/web_platoforms_hospital_duty_roster.pdf | https://stream.platoforms.com/system/doc-template/dt6jftq2fkv/fillable.pdf (page https://templates.platoforms.com/pdf/hospital-staff-duty-roster-pdf) | PlatoForms free fillable template (licence text not verified) - test fixture only | Blank 3-page form |
| pdf/chrome_*.pdf, pymupdf_*.pdf, libreoffice_*.pdf, scan_*.pdf, truth.json | Generated by backend/tests/breakers/rw_make_pdfs.py with Google Chrome headless (Skia/PDF), PyMuPDF Story and drawing API, LibreOffice 'soffice --convert-to pdf' (from openpyxl XLSX and from pandoc DOCX), and a raster scan simulation (render 100/130 dpi, rotate 1.5/-2 deg, blur, gaussian noise, JPEG q60) | n/a (invented data) | Ground truth in truth.json |
